description.value:
You learn the following additional Cauldron Rituals:

Beguiling Performance. Choose one creature. When the target performs a Perform check, it can treat a d20 roll of 8 or lower as a 9. If the Perform check is successful, it treats the result of the roll as 1 step better.

Drunkard's Luck. Choose one creature. When the target makes a Carouse check, it adds your spellcasting ability modifier to the result of the d20 roll.

Eagle Eyes. Choose one creature. When the target performs a Guard check, it can treat a d20 roll of 8 or lower as a 9. If the Guard check results in an encounter, the target cannot be surprised and adds your spellcasting ability modifier to its initiative roll.

Gutter Remedies. When you perform an Attend check, you can treat a d20 roll of 8 or lower as a 9. If your Attend check is successful, you roll an additional d4 and add it to the result of the die on the result column.

Magpie's Blessing. Choose one creature. When the target makes a Pickpocket check, it rolls 2d8 and adds them to the result of the die on the result column if the check was successful. If the check was a failure, it adds your spellcasting ability modifier to any checks made to evade the authorities.

Twisted Fortune. Choose one creature. The target rolls 2d8 and adds them to the result of the die on the result column, regardless of whether the Gambling check was successful or not.
